name: dotdotpwn
highlights: -m — Module [http | http-url | ftp | tftp | payload | stdout]
-O — Operating System detection for intelligent fuzzing (nmap)
-o — Operating System type if known ("windows", "unix" or "generic")
-d — Depth of traversals (e.g. deepness 3 equals to ../../../; default: 6)
-f — Specific filename (e.g. /etc/motd; default: according to OS detected, defaults in Traversa
-E — Add @Extra_files in TraversalEngine.pm (e.g. web.config, httpd.conf, etc.)
-S — Use SSL for HTTP and Payload module (not needed for http-url, use a https:// url instead)

flags.name: -m
flags.description: Module [http | http-url | ftp | tftp | payload | stdout]

flags.name: -h
flags.description: Hostname

flags.name: -O
flags.description: Operating System detection for intelligent fuzzing (nmap)

flags.name: -o
flags.description: Operating System type if known ("windows", "unix" or "generic")

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Service version detection (banner grabber)

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Depth of traversals (e.g. deepness 3 equals to ../../../; default: 6)

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Specific filename (e.g. /etc/motd; default: according to OS detected, defaults in TraversalEngine.pm)

flags.name: -E
flags.description: Add @Extra_files in TraversalEngine.pm (e.g. web.config, httpd.conf, etc.)

flags.name: -S
flags.description: Use SSL for HTTP and Payload module (not needed for http-url, use a https:// url instead)

flags.name: -u
flags.description: URL with the part to be fuzzed marked as TRAVERSAL (e.g. http://foo:8080/id.php?x=TRAVERSAL&y=31337)

flags.name: -k
flags.description: Text pattern to match in the response (http-url & payload modules - e.g. "root:" if trying /etc/passwd)

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Filename with the payload to be sent and the part to be fuzzed marked with the TRAVERSAL keyword

flags.name: -x
flags.description: Port to connect (default: HTTP=80; FTP=21; TFTP=69)

flags.name: -t
flags.description: Time in milliseconds between each test (default: 300 (.3 second))

flags.name: -X
flags.description: Use the Bisection Algorithm to detect the exact deepness once a vulnerability has been found

flags.name: -e
flags.description: File extension appended at the end of each fuzz string (e.g. ".php", ".jpg", ".inc")

flags.name: -U
flags.description: Username (default: 'anonymous')

flags.name: -P
flags.description: Password (default: 'dot@dot.pwn')

flags.name: -M
flags.description: HTTP Method to use when using the 'http' module [GET | POST | HEAD | COPY | MOVE] (default: GET)

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Report filename (default: 'HOST_MM-DD-YYYY_HOUR-MIN.txt')

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Break after the first vulnerability is found

flags.name: -q
flags.description: Quiet mode (doesn't print each attempt)

flags.name: -C
flags.description: Continue if no data was received from host
